{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify the latest (highest sample_seq) row for each patient
# Since sample_seq is higher for later assays, keep the row with max sample_seq per patient
latest_data = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that we now have one row per patient
print("After deduplication, number of patients:", len(latest_data))
print("Severity value counts in latest data:", latest_data['severity'].value_counts())

# Calculate the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_fraction = latest_data['severity'].value_counts().get('severe', 0) / len(latest_data)

print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {severe_fraction}")"}
